thread:
maya: Heads-up — int4 onboard of rwd-v3.2-small in staging shows a long-doc MRR drop (~6.2% at >=4k tokens) vs float32. Canary at 5% traffic. Need triage and a quick gate tweak.
arjun: link to the dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/onboard/rwd-v3.2-small/int4 — looks pretty specific to longctx slices
lina: Is the regression also visible in rerank flows or only generator scoring? Any latency regression?
samir: quick pass on evals: generator perplexity ~1.05x, but the longdoc MRR slice down 6%. short prompts (<=512) look fine. latency +3% p95 only.
maya: ok — two levers: tighten promotion thresholds for longctx OR expand immediate fallback for requests over token-length. proposal:

- change promote criteria: require MRR delta <= 3% across all slices and longdoc delta <= 2%
- auto-fallback rule: if slice.token_len >= 2000 and MRR_delta >= 4% then route to rwd-v3.1-fp32

arjun: +1 on conservative longdoc gating. also suggest adding a temporary sampling rule to increase shadow comparisons on longctx so we get more stats quickly.
lina: what about an interim A/B rollback for the 5% canary? we can shrink to 1% and divert longctx to previous model.

maya: doing that now — creating an A/B holdback with routing override for token_len >= 2000 -> rwd-v3.1-fp32, canary reduced to 1% overall.

deploy-bot: rollout request received: reduce-canary rwd-v3.2-small int4 -> new-weights {canary:1%, holdback-longctx:100%} — starting change.

samir: ran a quick simulated traffic replay on staging with new routing override. longdoc MRR uplifted back to baseline in the simulation. need realtime monitor alert on the live change though.

arjun: tiny config snippet for auto-fallback rule (put this in rollout config):
```
match: request.token_len >= 2000
action: route_to: rwd-v3.1-fp32
trigger: mrr_delta >= 0.04
```

lina: note: keep an eye on user-visible latency for rerouted long requests — routing to fp32 might add ~40-60ms p95 on some paths.
maya: raising alert thresholds: add a telemetry guard — if routed_longctx_errors > 0.5% or p95_latency_increase > 100ms for 10m then auto-pause and notify #eng-oncall.

deploy-bot: change applied. canary now at 1%, longctx override active. alert:AB_HOLDBACK_ENGML created.

samir: copying results to the onboard ticket and attaching replay traces. initial signals look good; we'll keep holdback for 24h and collect more shadow samples.

maya: owner: samir for 24h watch, lina you own the gate config PR for the promote/rollback thresholds. arjun, please add longctx slices to the daily eval job.

lina: working on PR now — will link shortly. :thumbsup:

maya: thanks all. follow-up in 6h with a short status update. if anything spikes, we rollback to v3.1 globally.

arjun: noted. thanks.
